stop_rule: Stop after two consecutive primary-source/related-work rounds yield no mechanism changing transfer representation, applicability test, negative-transfer control or benchmark design.

rounds.note: Absorbed memory-transfer / analogy-retrieval as non-novelty; kept explicit assumption+falsifier gate.

rounds.basis: Existing nearest-work closures (P5_NEAREST_WORK_CLOSURE_2026-08-16.md, NEAREST_WORK_V2_AUDIT_2026-08-16.md, CROSS.EXPERIENCE.v0.md) without live arXiv API
rounds.note: Skill-lifecycle, harmful-skill admission, transport-under-assumptions, and CBR/algorithm-selection parents already covered; no new transfer object field.

rounds.basis: Second pass over the same local citation set plus orion.transfer.types structural-score-is-not-authority invariant
rounds.note: Surface similarity remains a retrieval heuristic. Two consecutive flat rounds.

rows.title: Memory Transfer Learning
rows.mechanism: Cross-domain gains attributed mainly to high-level meta-knowledge; low-level traces often cause negative transfer.
rows.effect: ORION must not claim memory transfer. Low-level trajectory copy is a negative-transfer control, not a candidate cell.

rows.title: AGENTCL
rows.mechanism: Controlled task streams are required to reveal reusable experience; held-out settings can expose memory-induced degradation.
rows.effect: Independent source/target family slots and held-out targets are mandatory. Memory presence is not transfer evidence.

rows.title: SkillLearnBench
rows.mechanism: Continual skill-learning gains are inconsistent; self-feedback can induce recursive drift.
rows.effect: Skill/instruction memory is a matched baseline, not an authority grant.

rows.title: When Continual Learning Moves to Memory
rows.mechanism: External memory relocates, rather than removes, the stability-plasticity problem.
rows.effect: Content-addressed receipts and retained harmful candidates are required; memory offload is not a solution.

rows.title: Reason Analogically via Cross-domain Prior Knowledge
rows.mechanism: Cross-domain analogical transfer is conditionally useful, so analogy retrieval is not enough.
rows.effect: Strikes standalone novelty of analogical retrieval. Surface similarity cannot admit transfer.

rows.title: Analogical Deep Research
rows.mechanism: Treats analogy retrieval as a causal/structural problem and argues that cross-confirming analogies can distinguish mechanism from coincidence.
rows.effect: Independent-domain cross-confirmation stays a retrieval aid, never an authority grant.

rows.title: IsoSci
rows.mechanism: Isomorphic problem structure can still require domain-specific knowledge.
rows.effect: Assumption mismatch must refuse transfer even when signatures look isomorphic.

rows.title: Partial Transportability for Domain Generalization
rows.mechanism: Conditional transport under explicit structural assumptions.
rows.effect: Assumption-aware transport is prior art; ORION residual is mechanic-contract receipts plus authority boundaries.

rows.title: Sheaf-Theoretic Transport and Obstruction for Detecting Scientific Theory Shift in AI Agents
rows.mechanism: Transport/gluing/obstruction applied to scientific representational change.
rows.effect: Adjacent to P3 obstruction, not a mechanic-contract transfer object. Revisit only if it supplies applicability receipts.

rows.title: Ratchet
rows.mechanism: Self-evolving skill lifecycle with held-out transfer and mechanism ablations.
rows.effect: Held-out transfer and ablation are required protocol pieces, not ORION novelty.

rows.title: Verifier-as-Gatekeeper / skill-contamination study
rows.mechanism: Harmful skill admission can contaminate later self-evolution; frozen-pool transfer is tested.
rows.effect: Every harmful transfer candidate must be retained. Admission is fail-closed.

rows.title: PAST-Bench
rows.mechanism: Experience-on/off tests for whether retained experience causes later fresh-session improvement.
rows.effect: No-transfer vs transfer comparison is a parent baseline family.

rows.title: SEVA
rows.mechanism: Iterated self-evolution can create benchmark specialists with cross-benchmark regression.
rows.effect: Worst-family and negative-transfer rate stay primary; average gain cannot hide harm.

rows.title: PACE
rows.mechanism: Anytime-valid acceptance tests for self-evolving agents.
rows.effect: Acceptance testing is absorbed. Does not supply a mechanic-contract transfer object.

rows.title: Validation, robustness and transfer can disagree during self-evolution
rows.mechanism: Additional rounds are not monotone improvement; transfer can diverge from validation.
rows.effect: Frozen splits before outcomes; validation success is not transfer evidence.

rows.title: Case-Based Reasoning: Foundational Issues, Methodological Variations, and System Approaches
rows.mechanism: Retrieve, reuse, revise, retain prior episodes.
rows.effect: Episode reuse is the parent of trajectory/summary baselines. CBR retrieve is not contract admission.

rows.title: The Algorithm Selection Problem
rows.mechanism: Select among algorithms using problem features; parent of algorithm-selection meta-learning.
rows.effect: Portfolio/algorithm selection is absorbed. Structural score may rank candidates for inspection only.

rows.title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
rows.mechanism: Named reusable software structure without evidence-bound receipts or authority boundaries.
rows.local_source: issue #286 search term software design pattern transfer; no equivalent local receipt mechanism
rows.effect: Patterns are not mechanic-contract transfer. Rejected as an equivalent representation.

rows.title: ORION V1/V2 structural similarity heuristic
rows.mechanism: Far-domain structural score is a retrieval heuristic and never grants transfer authority.
rows.effect: Surface-similarity selector is the frozen baseline, not an authority.

rows.title: Continual and experiential learning as parent disciplines
rows.mechanism: Persistent experience, replay, memory consolidation and cross-session adaptation.
rows.effect: Generic experience retention is not scientific mechanic-contract transfer.

rows.title: RAKL donor/transfer inventory
rows.mechanism: Local engineering inventory of donor mechanics and transfer answers.
rows.effect: Program-synthesis-like component reuse inside ORION remains LOCAL_ENGINEERING_ONLY.
